title: 우리는 멋쟁이 브레멘 음악대!
author: 뮤토책방

villagePlace.name: 달빛 하모니 오두막
villagePlace.description: 네 마리 동물 친구들이 따뜻한 우정으로 꿈을 노래하는 아늑한 숲속 쉼터예요.

summary: 당나귀, 강아지, 고양이, 수탉이 함께 음악대를 만들었어요!

pages.full_text: 화창한 햇살이 비치는 푸른 숲길, 늙은 당나귀가 터덜터덜 걸어가고 있었어요. 비록 힘은 빠졌지만 가슴속엔 멋진 꿈이 반짝였지요. "히이잉! 나이가 들었다고 꿈까지 사라지는 건 아니지! 브레멘으로 가서 멋진 음악가가 될 테야!" 당나귀의 기타 소리가 숲속을 기분 좋게 울렸답니다.

pages.full_text: 길모퉁이를 돌자 헥헥 숨을 몰아쉬는 사냥개 한 마리가 보였어요. "어라? 개 친구, 왜 그렇게 풀이 죽어 있니?" 당나귀가 묻자 사냥개가 귀를 축 늘어뜨렸어요. "멍멍... 이젠 늙어서 토끼도 못 쫓는다고 집에서 쫓겨났어." 당나귀가 활짝 웃으며 말했어요. "무슨 소리! 나랑 같이 브레멘으로 가자! 넌 멋진 탬버린을 칠 수 있잖아!"

pages.full_text: 둘이서 발을 맞추어 걷다 보니, 담장 위에 홀로 웅크려 한숨을 쉬는 고양이를 만났어요. "야옹, 이젠 쥐를 못 잡는다고 구박만 받았는걸." "걱정 마, 야옹아! 우리는 나이가 들어도 노래할 수 있어! 우리의 합창단에 들어오렴!" 고양이는 반짝이는 눈으로 싱긋 웃으며 친구들의 손을 꼭 잡았어요.

pages.full_text: 어느새 울타리 위에서 목청껏 울부짖는 수탉도 만났답니다. "꼬끼오! 내일이면 수프 냄비에 들어갈 신세야!" "친구야, 날개를 펴고 우리와 함께 노래하자! 너의 힘찬 목소리가 꼭 필요해!" 마침내 네 친구는 어깨를 겯고 신나게 행진하기 시작했어요. 둘보다는 셋, 셋보다는 넷이 모이니 온 숲이 희망으로 가득 찼지요!

pages.full_text: 숲속에 밤이 찾아왔을 때, 저 멀리 따뜻한 불빛이 반짝이는 오두막 하나가 보였어요. 살금살금 다가가 창문 안을 들여다보았더니, 어머나! 욕심쟁이 도둑들이 맛있는 음식을 쌓아두고 깔깔거리고 있지 뭐예요! "저기서 하룻밤 쉬어가면 좋을 텐데..." 배고픈 친구들의 배에서 꼬르륵 소리가 났어요.

pages.full_text: 혼자서는 도둑들을 쫓아낼 수 없지만, 함께 뭉치면 엄청난 힘이 생겨요! "모두 내 등에 타! 우리는 세상에서 가장 웅장한 음악대야!" 당나귀 등 위에 개가, 개 위에 고양이가, 고양이 머리 위에 수탉이 척척 올라탔어요. 거대한 그림자가 창문에 비치자 친구들은 일제히 숨을 들이쉬었지요.

preschoolEnglishPages.full_text: Old Donkey walks along. He plays the guitar. "Let's go to Bremen!"
He meets a dog. Dog looks very sad. "Come play with me!"
Look! A sad cat! Cat sighs on the wall. "Sing with us, Cat!"
Rooster cries loud. "Cock-a-doodle-doo! Help me!" Four friends march together.
Night comes in the woods. Look at that house! Bad robbers eat food.
We are strong together! Animals climb up high. Look at the shadow!
"One, two, three, sing!" Hee-haw! Woof! Meow! Robbers run away quickly.
They eat yummy food. "We did it together!" Good friends sing happily.

english.childEnglishTitle: We Are the Cool Bremen Town Musicians!

childEnglishPages.full_text: The sun was shining brightly in the green forest. An old donkey walked slowly along the path. He was tired, but he had a big dream. "Hee-haw! Old animals can dream too! I will go to Bremen and become a great musician!" His sweet guitar music filled the quiet woods.

dialogue_list.text: The sun was shining brightly in the green forest, and an old donkey walked slowly along the path.
He was tired, but he had a big dream in his heart.
"Hee-haw! Old animals can dream too! I will go to Bremen and become a great musician!"
His sweet guitar music filled the quiet woods.
Around the corner, he saw a tired dog panting for breath.
"Hello, dog! Why are you looking so sad?"
"Woof... I am too old to catch rabbits, so I lost my home."
"Come with me to Bremen! You can play the tambourine!"

childEnglishPages.full_text: Around the corner, the donkey saw a panting hound dog. "Hello, dog! Why are you so sad?" The dog put his ears down. "Woof... I am too old to chase rabbits, so my master kicked me out." The donkey smiled warmly. "Don't worry! Come to Bremen with me. You can play the tambourine!"

As they walked together, they saw a cat on a stone wall. The cat sighed softly. "Meow, I cannot catch mice anymore, so no one likes me." "Don't worry, friend! We can still sing together! Join our music band!" The cat smiled with bright eyes and held their hands tightly.

dialogue_list.text: As they walked together, they saw a lonely cat sighing on a wall.
"Meow, I cannot catch mice anymore, so no one likes me."
"Don't worry, friend! We can still sing together! Join our music band!"
The cat smiled with bright eyes and joined the happy friends.

childEnglishPages.full_text: Soon, they met a rooster crying loudly on a fence. "Cock-a-doodle-doo! Tomorrow, I will be cooked into soup!" "Open your wings, friend! Come and sing with us! We need your loud voice!" The four friends marched happily together. With four good friends, the forest was full of hope!

dialogue_list.text: Soon, they met a rooster crying loudly on top of a fence.
"Cock-a-doodle-doo! Tomorrow, I will be cooked into soup!"
"Open your wings, friend! Come and sing with us! We need your loud voice!"
The four friends marched happily together, and the forest was full of hope!

childEnglishPages.full_text: Night fell on the dark forest. Far away, a cozy cabin shone with warm light. They tiptoed close and looked inside the window. Oh my! Bad robbers were laughing around a table full of food! "I wish we could rest in there tonight..." The friends' hungry tummies went rumble, rumble.

dialogue_list.text: Night fell on the dark forest, and a cozy cabin shone with warm light.
They looked inside the window, and bad robbers were laughing around lots of delicious food!
"I wish we could rest in there tonight..."
Their hungry tummies went rumble, rumble.
One animal was small, but together they had great power!
"Climb onto my back! We are the greatest band in the world!"
The dog hopped on the donkey, the cat on the dog, and the rooster on the cat.
A giant shadow fell on the window, and the friends took a deep breath.

childEnglishPages.full_text: One animal could not stop the robbers, but together they were strong! "Climb onto my back! We are the greatest band in the world!" The dog jumped on the donkey, the cat climbed on the dog, and the rooster flew onto the cat's head. A giant shadow appeared on the window, and they took a deep breath.

dialogue_list.text: With loud cries and a crashing window, the robbers turned pale with fear.
"Yikes! A monster! A forest ghost is here!"
The robbers ran far away, and the friends won the day!

childEnglishPages.full_text: "One, two, three, make music!" Hee-haw! Woof-woof! Meow-meow! Cock-a-doodle-doo! Crash! The window broke with a very loud noise! The robbers turned pale with fear. "Yikes! A monster! A forest ghost is here!" The robbers ran away into the woods and never looked back. It was a great victory!

Now the warm cabin was theirs. The four friends sat by the fireplace and shared the delicious food. "Look what we did together! Nothing is impossible!" Under the starry night sky, they sang a beautiful song. Their sweet friendship kept the cozy cabin warm and full of hope forever.

dialogue_list.text: The four friends sat by the warm fireplace and ate the yummy food.
"Look what we did together! Nothing is impossible!"
"Yes! When we are together, we are never afraid!"
Their sweet friendship kept the cozy cabin warm and bright forever.
